sentences.text: The petitioners are accused Nos.1 to 3 in the above case.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned counsel for the defacto complainant as well as the learned Public Prosecutor in detail.
3.
In this matter, offence under Section 498A read with 34 of IPC is alleged to have been committed by the accused.
Complainant is none other than the wife of the first petitioner.
In fact, the quashment sought is for, on the ground of settlement, acting on the affidavit filed by the defacto complainant supporting settlement.

sentences.text: The learned Public Prosecutor would submit when statement of the defacto complainant was recorded, she stated that she is not ready to settle the dispute in between the first accused and herself, as other matters are also pending, though she has no objection for quashing the proceedings against accused Nos.2 and 3.
He also submitted that the 2nd petitioner is not at all an accused and therefore, the quashment does not arise.
6. As things stand now, it is discernible that the defacto complainant is agreeable to quash the proceedings against petitioners 2 and 3.
But the 2 nd petitioner is not an accused.

Hence,
quashment does not arise in relation to him.
Therefore, I am inclined to quash the proceedings against the 3rd petitioner.

Accordingly, all further proceedings in Annexure I Final Report in Crime 2024:KER:69446 CRL.MC NO. 8849 OF 2023 No.899/2021 of Chadayamangalam Police Station,
now pending as C.C.No.1729/2021 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court,
Kadakkal, Kollam, against the 3 rd petitioner stand quashed.

sentences.text: 7. The settlement prayer at the instance of the husband/first petitioner could not be considered since the defacto complainant is not amenable for settlement, highlighting pendency of cases in between them before the Family Court.
Therefore, the said prayer stands disallowed.
However, the first petitioner is at liberty to file a fresh Crl.M.C to address his grievance, if there was settlement hereafter.
Accordingly, this petition stands disposed of as indicated above.
